title: The Meta vs. The Mission

Configure when establishing a review policy for platform content

content:
Each platform has its quirks and each meta is real. But here’s my take: chasing the meta is a treadmill. You can farm readers with the right tropes and timing, but you’ll also burn out faster than a protagonist with a cursed EXP bar.At Bardic Planet, we believe fiction is sacred. We’ll keep analysing the meta, sure—but we’re here to build legends, not just trend-chase.Because sure, you can ride the meta. But keep grinding goblins, and eventually you’ll unlock the secret achievement:

```
“Congratulations, you are now Greg the Goblin, Level 1, please enjoy your stick."
```

Clone_v2 is the Bard-in-Chief of Bardic Planet. When he’s not testing how many diapers it takes to survive the WebNovel grind, he’s writing original web fiction on Royal Road.Check out: Captured Sky—a brutal, high-stakes fantasy set in the unforgiving world of the Dungeon.New chapters drop twice a week.
